# zkSync Bridge

> zkSync Bridge moves ETH and ERC-20s between Ethereum and ZKsync Era through native messaging, with your own wallet signing every step.

## Key facts
- Route: Ethereum (chain ID 1)  ZKsync Era (chain ID 324)
- Deposit: typically minutes after L1 inclusion
- Withdraw: waits for batch execution, delay, then L1 proof
- Gas: ETH is native gas on both sides
- Custody: Non-custodial — your wallet signs everything
- Verify: Use the official portal; beware fake bridge sites
